title: NATS request/reply runner.unload.<host>.<env> (studio's dispatcher → a runner)
description: Core NATS request/reply on subject `runner.unload.<host>.<env>` (no queue group: one runner per host and env), bare JSON. One GPU per host (contracts/README.md, Two envs on one host): before the dispatcher releases a run to env E of host H it needs every other env of H to hold no weights; it asks each one whose hosts value lists `resident` components with this request. The runner, when idle, unloads every component (pinned ones included; adapters and cached handles too), frees its device memory (MLX: mx.clear_cache(); torch MPS: synchronize() then empty_cache()), rewrites its hosts key, then replies. While a run is in progress it does not unload and replies `busy`. Studio waits 60 s.

for_env.description: the env of the same host that is about to load (for the runner's log)

run_id.description: the run waiting for the GPU (for the log; never shown to users)

unloaded_gb.description: what it freed (0 when it held nothing)

resident.description: always empty: the hosts key the runner rewrote before replying says the same

code.description: busy: a run is in progress (the dispatcher asks again on a later pass); internal: unloading failed (logged by the runner)
